_comment: Promotion evidence manifest. A rollout gate may ONLY be declared ON (immune.py literal True) when it appears here as promoted, backed by the money gates (R2 profitability + WFA deflated Sharpe). test_R31 enforces: promoted == declared-on, and every promotion carries evidence fields. An empty promoted set is the correct baseline (all gates OFF).

gate.deflated_sr: trials-deflated pooled Sharpe from the WFA report (> 0 required)
gate.profitable_tickers: N/M tickers with positive EV crossing the R2 profitability gate
gate.wfa_file: path to the WFA JSON that produced the numbers
